sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Saksham Singh,Mohak Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shamim Ahmed,J.
Heard Shri Saksham Singh, learned Counsel for the applicant, Shri Arpit Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State-opposite party Nos.1 and 2 and perused the material placed on record.

At the outset, learned A.G.A. for the State-opposite party Nos.1 and 2 made a preliminary objection regarding the maintainability of the present application as the impugned proceedings of Complaint Case No.34 of 2006 under Sections 498A/406 I.P.C. is pending in the court of Additional Civil Judge, Jodhpur, Rajasthan, thus, this Court has no jurisdiction to entertain this application.

sentences.text: Learned Counsel for the applicant submits that he does not want to press this application on merits and wants to withdraw the same with liberty to approach the competent court for redressal of his grievance.
In view of the above, the present application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to learned Counsel for the applicant to approach the competent court for redressal of his grievance.
